title: Command Envelope
description: Wrapper for command messages on the OneMind NATS bus. Commands are imperatives published on cmd.* subjects. UI buttons and automation publish commands; backend services (om-router, om-control-plane, om-tak-projector) validate and execute them, emitting result events (evt.command.accepted, evt.command.rejected, evt.command.executed, evt.command.failed). See docs/CONTROL-PLANE.md command model. This envelope is distinct from the event envelope — commands may be rejected; events are immutable facts.

v.description: Schema version. Start at 1. Consumers pin a minimum v and tolerate unknowns.

ts.description: Command timestamp — RFC3339 / ISO8601 with millisecond precision.

cmd.description: Dotted command type mirroring the NATS subject grammar (e.g. 'cmd.entity.node.zeus-mac.tak.show', 'cmd.integration.homeassistant.test', 'cmd.workflow.create').

source.description: Actor ID that issued this command (e.g. 'ui.onemindos-command', 'agent.legacy', 'om-router').

subject.description: The NATS subject this command is published on. May include dynamic tokens (e.g. entity IDs).

data.description: Command payload. Schema varies by command type. The command handler validates and interprets this according to the 'cmd' field.

corr.description: Correlation ID — links this command to related events in a workflow chain.

causation.description: Causation ID — the 'id' of the event that caused this command to be issued.

trace.description: Distributed trace ID for OpenTelemetry / Jaeger integration.

approval.description: Approval metadata for protected command classes. Commands matching protected patterns (cmd.drone.launch, cmd.robot.move, cmd.intercept.*, cmd.service.restart.*, cmd.nex.workload.stop.*, cmd.integration.*.write) require operator approval by default.

required.description: Whether this command requires human approval before execution.

approver.description: Actor ID of the approver (filled when approved).

dry_run.description: When true, the handler should validate and log the command without executing it. Used for testing.
